## Checklist

- [ ] Edge cases planned first
- [ ] Tests that fail before and pass after
- [ ] Every changed line re-read; whole diff reviewed a second time
- [ ] Backend: Pint, Larastan, tests, composer audit — zero errors, zero new warnings
- [ ] App: flutter analyze, flutter test (+ golden), release build — zero errors, zero new warnings
- [ ] Landing: build + Lighthouse (Phase 5)
- [ ] gitleaks clean; no secrets, real student data, receipts or backups
- [ ] No price, buy button or payment link in the app
- [ ] No hard-coded UI text (all strings in translation files)
- [ ] No TODOs, no hacks, no skipped or weakened tests
